name: packman
description: Script runners and dependency intelligence right inside your package.json.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In untrusted workspaces Packman shows its Overlay but does not offer to run scripts.

packman.github.token.markdownDescription: Advanced override: a GitHub token for Dependency issue counts. No setup is needed when you're signed in to GitHub in the editor (Accounts menu): Packman uses that account, which allows 5,000 requests/hour. Until Packman has access, each Block summary offers **Sign in to GitHub**; without access GitHub allows only 60 requests/hour per IP, and issue counts pause when that runs out. Set a token here only to use a different account. Public repo metadata needs no scopes.

packman.socket.apiToken.markdownDescription: Socket.org API token (end-user). Required together with `#packman.socket.orgSlug#` to show Socket scores on Dependencies.

packman.socket.orgSlug.markdownDescription: Socket organization slug for `POST /orgs/{org}/purl`. Required together with `#packman.socket.apiToken#`.

packman.overlay.enabled.markdownDescription: Show the Packman Overlay in the `package.json` text editor: a ▶ Run action on each script (or one Trust workspace action), a Dependency signal beside each Dependency (latest version, open issues and Socket score), Dependency details on hover, and a Block summary with Refresh above each dependency block. Signals are fetched when you open a `package.json`, type a new Dependency or click Refresh, and cached for an hour. `Packman: Toggle Overlay` hides or shows the Overlay for the current session.
